requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C1 - existing court and county
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C1 - existing court and county
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the section 19c filing must identify the existing prostitution-related matter, and this fact lives in a court record the platform has never seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the Oklahoma court and county where the prostitution-related case was filed - copy both from the existing docket or a court order in that case, or ask that court's clerk

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the section 19c filing must identify the existing prostitution-related matter, and this fact lives in a court record the platform has never seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the case number of the prostitution-related case - copy it from the existing docket or a court order in that case

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the bound compiled pathway limits this route to prostitution-related records, and the platform has never seen the participant's court file
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the exact prostitution-related offense or charge, including the count and statute if stated - copy it from the charging document, docket or disposition order

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the filing must identify the record for which relief is requested, and the platform has never seen the participant's court file
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the disposition of that offense or charge and the date the court entered it - copy both from the docket or disposition order

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C5 - trafficking and causal connection
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C5 - trafficking and causal connection
requiredBeforeFiling.why: section 19c reaches a prostitution-related record only where the offense resulted from trafficking, and that connection is the participant's own fact, which the platform has never seen and never asks to be narrated
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the statement legal aid or an attorney advises that the identified offense was committed as a result of your being a victim of human trafficking - state only the connection counsel advises stating, and do not write an account of what was done to you

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the bound legal-design record states that relief under section 19c is for good cause, so the filing must state grounds, and those grounds are counsel-advised rather than platform-held
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the grounds legal aid or an attorney advises you to state as good cause for expunging the identified record under section 19c

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C7 - relief requested under section 19c
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C7 - relief requested under section 19c
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the court filing must state the relief requested, and the exact remedy for the participant's facts is counsel-advised rather than platform-held
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the exact relief under 22 O.S. Sec. 19c that legal aid or an attorney advises you to request for the identified record - do not guess, because section 19c is a limited sealing remedy and not vacatur

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the bound route records trafficking nexus evidence as this packet's route-specific supporting component, while the compiled pathway directs the sensitive facts and proof to legal aid or an attorney
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: identify only the trafficking-nexus evidence legal aid or an attorney selected: its document or evidence type, title or date, and issuer or holder - do not write an account of the trafficking or attach a survivor narrative here, and ask the clerk or counsel which protected-filing mechanism applies to anything sensitive before it is filed

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C9 - persons and agencies to be notified
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C9 - persons and agencies to be notified
requiredBeforeFiling.why: under 22 O.S. Sec. 19 as amended by the enacted 2026 Senate Bill 2030 the court provides 30 days' notice to those agencies, and the court can direct notice only to the persons and agencies the filing identifies for this record
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the prosecuting agency, the arresting agency, the Oklahoma State Bureau of Investigation and any other person or agency the court should notify, as counsel or the court clerk identifies them for your record - you list them so the court can direct its own notice, and you certify no notice yourself

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item O1 - records this order covers
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item O1 - records this order covers
requiredBeforeFiling.why: an order under section 19c operates on identified records, and those records come from a court file the platform has never seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the records to be expunged, written exactly as items C1 to C4 of the petition identify them, as legal aid or an attorney advises stating them on the order

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item O2 - persons and agencies this order is directed to
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item O2 - persons and agencies this order is directed to
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the order reaches the persons and agencies it names, and those are per-matter facts the platform does not hold
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the persons and agencies the order binds, written as item C9 of the petition identifies them, as legal aid or an attorney advises stating them on the order
